tasks.title: Control Center Live Architecture - 3 phases
tasks.description: Phase 1: Extend Status Board API to serve all CC data. Phase 2: React app reads live (no more static JSON or GitHub pushes for data). Phase 3: Every agent workflow posts status after each run. Approved by Krish.
tasks.nextStep: Arlo to build in order: Phase 1 then 2 then 3. Full spec in plan doc.

tasks.title: Build Systems Monitor + Control Center Systems Tab
tasks.description: Full service inventory + hourly health checks + credit monitoring + Notion Systems tab + ops-bot alerts + weekly Agentops cost report to Vera.
tasks.nextStep: Approve spec then Arlo builds N8N workflow + Systems tab in Control Center
